blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `sdk.admin.productType` set of methods used to send requests to Medusa's Admin API routes.

This method creates a product type. It sends a request to the
[Create Product Type](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/admin#product-types\_postproducttypes)
